name: Field Protect
description: Adds a client-side 'unlock' guard over configured entity-form field widgets to prevent accidental edits.
project_description:
If you have fields that editors should be able to change, but you need to ensure they understand the consequences, then Field Protect can be useful.

 This is a good complement for help text and submission guidelines. Help text is great so editors can answer the question What should I put here? . Field protect will go a step further and it will ensure that editors confirm they understand the implications of changing that particular field.

 

 
 
 
 
 📹 Watch the video 📹 
 
 
 
 
 Use cases 
 
 You want to ensure editors can change the background image, but they should know that overlaid text should be readable with the new image. 
 You want editors tagging content according to your organization's documentation. 
 You want to ensure editors read the style guide before they edit the body field. 
 ... 
 
 Configuration 
 Make sure you adjust the module permissions to fit your use case.
